title: Repository and deployed Supabase divergence
mitigation: Pin branch, commit, project reference, migration head, and schema inventory; compare staging to repository before promotion.
trigger: Any schema, policy, grant, bucket, or migration mismatch.
contingency: Freeze promotion, restore the last verified migration head, and reconcile through a reviewed additive change.

title: Event migration loss or duplication
mitigation: Use stable ID mapping, dry-run backfill, quarantine, row/relationship reconciliation, and rollback rehearsal.
trigger: Any unexplained count, duplicate, orphan, or relationship delta.
contingency: Stop cutover, retain legacy reads, repair quarantined rows, and rerun reconciliation.

title: Branch reconciliation reintroduces legacy routes
mitigation: Classify every delta and enforce exact route/method registry plus navigation smoke.
trigger: A stale or duplicate route appears after reconciliation.
contingency: Disable the route, restore canonical redirect, and add a regression contract.

title: Role consolidation locks out valid managers
mitigation: Maintain an old-to-new role map and run the two-organization capability matrix.
trigger: A seeded valid persona loses an intended action.
contingency: Rollback the role assignment change and restore through an additive capability grant.

title: Storage privatization breaks existing links
mitigation: Inventory and migrate objects, use signed URLs, and verify recipient and outsider behavior.
trigger: Authorized recipients cannot open migrated files or old public URLs remain reachable.
contingency: Keep private access enforced, issue replacement signed links, and surface recoverable expired-link UX.

title: Workflow work expands launch scope
mitigation: Honor locked scope decisions; hide and server-deny deferred capabilities.
trigger: A deferred finance, signature, native, or provider surface becomes reachable.
contingency: Disable the surface and record the regression before continuing the wave.
